transcript: Speaker A: नमस्कार! एक बड़ी खबर है, अब इंग्लिश सीखना मुश्किल नहीं रहा। एक ऐसा ऐप आ चुका है जो आपको हिंदी में ही इंग्लिश बोलना सिखाता है। नाम है Speak Easy ऐप। जो लोग सोचते थे 'मुझसे नहीं होगा', जो लोग सोचते थे 'मेरी उम्र निकल गई', वो भी आज कॉन्फिडेंटली इंग्लिश बोल रहे हैं। क्योंकि यहां कोई जज नहीं करता। Speak Easy ऐप पे एक AI टीचर है जो सिर्फ सिखाती है। गलती पर डांटती नहीं, सुधारती है। बार-बार, धैर्य के साथ। रोज़ सिर्फ 10-15 मिनट की प्रैक्टिस भी काफी है। अगर आप भी सीरियसली इंग्लिश सीखना चाहते हो तो आज ही शुरू करो। Click on the install button and download Speakeasy app. [Hello! There is big news, learning English is no longer difficult. An app has arrived that teaches you to speak English in Hindi itself. The name is Speak Easy app. People who used to think 'I can't do it', people who used to think 'my age has passed', they too are speaking English confidently today. Because no one judges here. On the Speak Easy app, there is an AI teacher who only teaches. She doesn't scold you for mistakes, she corrects them. Again and again, with patience. Just 10-15 minutes of practice daily is enough. If you also seriously want to learn English, start today. Click on the install button and download Speakeasy app.] Speaker B: अभी Speak Easy ऐप डाउनलोड करें और फर्राटेदार इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the Speak Easy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: BREAKING NEWS, INDIA NEWS, Speak easy AI, Install Now, GET IT ON Google Play [BREAKING NEWS, INDIA NEWS, Speak easy AI, Install Now, GET IT ON Google Play]
summary: An AI news anchor introduces the Speakeasy app, highlighting its non-judgmental AI teacher that patiently corrects mistakes. The ad targets learners of all ages, emphasizing that just 10-15 minutes of daily practice can build confidence. It ends with a call to action to download the app from Google Play.
